method: Toss the paneer in the Peri Peri and leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers with the sugar snap peas and sweetcorn and grill or griddle for 10-12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked.
Rest briefly and serve with flatbreads.

name: Romesco Pork Bake
blurb: A romesco bake of pork with cherry tomatoes.
method: Heat the oven to 190C fan. Layer the pork, cherry tomatoes and Romesco in a baking dish.
Top with cheese or breadcrumbs and bake for 30-35 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Rest for 5 minutes, then serve with pasta.

name: Lemon & Garlic Lentil Traybake
